posts.title: Vinod Wadhawan on the Futility of the God Idea
posts.description: God is postulated as the creator of everything there is. This is done by people who believe that every effect must have a cause. But then what is the cause, of which God is the effect? Many people stop being logical when this question is asked. This reel, created by Ms. Geeta Sharma, provides a brief discussion: https://youtube.com/shorts/6TbO7DDEL3U?si=cqNPgyLM9zPZSJQc
